name: Analytics and Algorithm Delivery (Public Trial, Node-Licensed Production)
description: Productized delivery for independent analysts, algorithm vendors and small teams: use free mode for a trial package anyone can run, and p2p mode for a production package bound to one customer node. The customer runs it locally, data never leaves their database, and the vendor's source is unreadable end to end. Built on MGC Blackbox 1.6.0, with a runnable minimal example and a delivery checklist.
author: MirginCipher Team
